name: passtheparcel
description: This is ParcelOS, a nice little project I've been working on for Crossroads! Just open it in your browser (https://richardkiselev.github.io/PassTheParcel). I was inspired to do this after seeing how great the Hack Club community was. I really just wanted to make a cool collaborative project that everyone could participate in. It would also make putting in hours easier. Instead of coming up with new complex systems, I could just make apps and add features.
